title: Sequin Tulle Batwing Sleeve Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Shimmer and shine in this dazzling evening dress! Featuring a sequin-adorned tulle overlay, elegant batwing sleeves, and a flowing silhouette, this gown is perfect for making a grand entrance at any formal event or special occasion.


Tips: Highly elastic fabric; stretches at least 2 inches.
Choose a size smaller for a snug fit.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Maxi.


Sleeve Style: Batwing sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises tulle.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
